verdict.rationale: Shopify POS's own documentation shows it can take contactless card payments on a smartphone with Tap to Pay. It also documents connecting peripherals through POS Hub, which gives a minimal path to taking payments. However, nothing documents pairing or registering a dedicated card reader, any setup steps, or how quickly a first payment can be made. missing for 10: documented card-reader pairing/registration flow, evidence of setup-to-first-payment within minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: Turn your smartphone into a checkout for on-the-go selling with Tap to Pay.
Tap to Pay works with contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and digital wallets for fast and smooth checkouts.
Add POS Hub to connect your peripherals to your tablet with rock-solid USB connectivity and built-in device monitoring.
